[LREG.7.2] The compiler must reject:

- Capture/binding-form length mismatches per [LREG.4.2].
- Named-capture / binding-form name mismatches per [LREG.3.3].
- A capture written outside the `where` position, or position-rule
  violations within it, per [LREG.4.1] / [LREG.2.3] / [LREG.2.4] /
  [LREG.2.5].
- Type mismatches per [LREG.4.5].
- Flag duplicates and unknown flags per [LREG.5.3] / [LREG.5.4].
- Non-literal right-hand-sides per [LREG.5.5].
